snippet.title: Obsidian Moon - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for Obsidian Moon, a noir horror detective game developed by Lost Cabinet Games. Players will navigate the dark streets of a Lovecraftian world to reveal a sinister plot. Investigate branching choices and interact with a variety of clue mechanics in Obsidian Moon, coming soon to PC (Steam).
